result.title: Diffusion-free Score Matching for Exact Conditional Sampling
result.summary: The success of modern score-based generative models is largely driven by diffusion-based training, which learns a collection of time-indexed score fields corresponding to progressively noisier versions of the data distribution. While such models achieve impressive sample quality, leveraging them for sound probabilistic inference---particularly sampling from arbitrary conditionals of the model---remains challenging. This difficulty arises because conditioning information is only available for clean data and not for the higher noise levels required to generate exact conditional samples. In this paper, we introduce DIffusion-free SCOre matching (DISCO), a principled approach that sidesteps the need for time-dependent score fields altogether. Our method is based on an objective that, while reminiscent of diffusion-based training, estimates only a single score of the (slightly perturbed) data distribution, for which the exact conditional score is readily obtained. In experiments, DISCO is competitive with state-of-the-art diffusion models in terms of sample quality. More importantly, DISCO yields a more faithful representation of the underlying data distribution and---crucially---enables accurate sampling from arbitrary conditionals, outperforming standard heuristic samplers. This capability opens the door to principled and flexible probabilistic reasoning with score-based models.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 DISCO：一个不依赖时间索引 score 场的 score matching 目标，只估计（轻微扰动）数据分布的单一 score，从而可直接取得精确条件 score，实现从任意条件分布采样。
AI.relevance_reason: 该工作属纯生成建模，与 VLM 推理无直接联系；但其「不用启发式引导、以精确条件 score 采样」的表述，可能为 latent 推理中如何以视觉证据为条件生成或筛选 latent 状态提供概念线索，可供核查。
